description: World Generation Info viewer addon for Just Enough Items (JEI)

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Readded REI compatibility in 26.3

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/compare/v1.4.5...v1.4.6

## What's Changed
* Updated to Minecraft 26.3 (JEI only for now)
* Add Traditional Chinese (zh_tw) translation for JEI WorldGen by @Andy2088-TW in https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/pull/15
* Fixed ore size never being applied correctly https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/issues/16

## New Contributors
* @Andy2088-TW made their first contribution in https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/pull/15

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/compare/v1.4.4...v1.4.5

## What's Changed
* Added display of max ore blob sizes and spawn attempts for the respective selected height

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/compare/v1.4.3...v1.4.4

## What's Changed
* Fixed caching preventing the game to start when cached mod-data is no longer readable due to changes to other mods, instead it will now just start without cached data, partial loads need data model changes for storage

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/compare/v1.4.2...v1.4.3

## What's Changed
* Added caching (toggleable in config) for data so that players on MP servers without the mod don't have to go into singleplayer on every startup

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2

## What's Changed
* Feature: Mekanism Compatibility in 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 (see #6 )
* Feature: Hiding of entries using the config file (see #1 )
* Fix: Bars should no longer exceed the draw area, instead they should be coloured differently to indicate an exceeding amount

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/compare/v1.1.2-26.1.X...v1.2.0

Added drop information to world gen blocks read from loot tables

This version is fully compatible with 1.0.0 servers, just the drops will not show (unless cached from singleplayer)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Larsens-Mods/JEIWorldGen/compare/v1.0.0-1.21...v1.1.0-1.21
